criteria.text: Repeating the auth bootstrap for a resolved session never regresses its status to 'checking'; the routed page is attached exactly once and keeps what the user entered.

Readiness waits on the session while sign-in is undetermined or the intent client has not opened yet, including for fleet-scoped domains. A client that was stopped after use does not disable anything: the next submit reopens it.
A fleet-scoped domain is ready as soon as the session has opened its intent client, with no role or organization.

An org-scoped domain is ready when the form or record carries an org id, when the record's service or LLM route does, or when exactly one organization is known. With none known the control is disabled with the reason shown beside it and becomes ready as soon as local data names one.

Readiness never depends on relay connectivity, discovery progress or catch-up. With no relay reachable a fleet-scoped intent is still signed and shown as pending, and a stopped client with a disconnected pool still accepts a create that is resent on reconnect.

When only the operator can resolve readiness (signed out, an intent client that cannot open, several organizations, an empty organization field) the control stays enabled and the explicit error is reported.
A click made while a control waits takes effect once the control is enabled instead of producing a failure, and form fields stay editable meanwhile.
Role derivation reports itself active while a live key envelope is still being decrypted.
